title: Cutting-Edge tools to build subscriptions
body: Our platform combines cutting-edge AI models with intuitive interfaces to streamline your development workflow and boost productivity.

card1.title: Team collaboration
card1.body: Discuss in context, mention teammates, and resolve threads without leaving the flow of work.

card2.title: Workflow Automation
card2.body: Trigger agents from events, chain tools with conditions.

card3.title: Omnichannel Messaging
card3.body: Send campaigns across email, chat, and more—every reply lands in one unified inbox.

card4.title: Enterprise-grade security
card4.body: Role-based access, audit trails, and fine-grained controls keep data locked down by default.

card5.title: Collaborative Analysis
card5.body: Turn scattered signals into shared understanding with live insights your whole team can explore.
